notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Scurry Oak.
You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
